dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral axis exhibit dark, low-intensity perimeters with sharp inward gradients to light-grey centers. A prominent 'O' structure on the mid-dorsal region shows a jagged, high-contrast exterior boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated near the neck and head transition. The lower lateral flank features scattered high-intensity (bright) pixel blobs that lack internal gradients, appearing as localized light-colored speckles.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an elongated, obtuse triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso. Centroids of the lateral high-intensity blobs form an irregular, non-linear chain roughly parallel to the ventral silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Parallel longitudinal dark-pixel striations are visible on the distal region of the hind flipper, distinct from the circular topology of the primary body.
